name: Madam Kaede
source:
The gracefully poised Madam Kaede, once the radiant musumeyaku of yesteryears, now bestows her wisdom and gaze upon the budding talents of the Revue. Her elegant silhouette is a constant presence, guiding the new petals as they bloom in the cherished garden of performing arts.

[From [url=https://yamino.itch.io/black-rose-revue]itch.io[/url]]
